title: LIA · Token & Cost
description: 유료 모델 호출 기록(llm_calls)과 시점별 단가(llm_prices)로 본 토큰·비용(D83). 지연 시간은 LIA · Overview.

panels.title: 기간 비용
panels.description: 단가가 있는 호출만 더한다. 오른쪽 '단가 없는 호출'이 0이 아니면 실제보다 작다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(cost_usd) AS usd FROM llm_call_costs WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at)

panels.title: 단가 없는 호출
panels.description: llm_prices 에 그 모델·토큰 종류의 단가가 없는 호출. 공식 가격표를 보고 단가를 넣는다(cost-policy).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS calls FROM llm_call_costs WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) AND NOT priced

panels.title: 개인화 1회당 비용
panels.description: 하루 한도 1회를 쓰는 요청(첫 개인화 분석 + 상황 반영 재생성)의 평균 비용. 인용 검증 실패로 다시 부른 시도까지 더한다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT purpose, group_key, count(*) AS attempts, sum(cost_usd) AS cost, bool_and(priced) AS priced,
         sum(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE accepted) AS accepted_cost, COALESCE(bool_or(accepted), false) AS answered,
         sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens
  FROM llm_call_costs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) AND group_key IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY purpose, group_key
)
SELECT avg(cost) AS usd FROM g WHERE priced AND purpose IN ('PERSONALIZED', 'ACTION_REVISION')

panels.title: 사용자 1명 하루 최대 비용(평균 단가 기준)
panels.description: 개인화 1회당 평균 비용 × 하루 한도(변수 daily_limit = lia.personalization.daily-limit).

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT purpose, group_key, count(*) AS attempts, sum(cost_usd) AS cost, bool_and(priced) AS priced,
         sum(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE accepted) AS accepted_cost, COALESCE(bool_or(accepted), false) AS answered,
         sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens
  FROM llm_call_costs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) AND group_key IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY purpose, group_key
)
SELECT avg(cost) * $daily_limit AS usd FROM g WHERE priced AND purpose IN ('PERSONALIZED', 'ACTION_REVISION')

SELECT date_trunc('day', called_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS time, purpose AS metric, sum(cost_usd) AS usd FROM llm_call_costs WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 일별 토큰 — 목적별
panels.description: 입력·출력(thinking 포함)·캐시 읽기·캐시 쓰기 토큰의 합.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', called_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS time, purpose AS metric, sum(COALESCE(input_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(output_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(cache_read_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(cache_write_tokens, 0)) AS tokens FROM llm_call_costs WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Layer B 단가 — 요청 1건
panels.description: PERSONALIZED = 첫 개인화(영향·대응을 한 호출로), ACTION_REVISION = 상황 반영 재생성. 둘 다 하루 한도를 1회씩 쓴다. cost_per_request 는 재시도 포함, accepted_cost_per_request 는 통과한 시도만. unanswered = 끝까지 답을 내지 못한 요청(인용 검증 실패 또는 호출 실패).

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT purpose, group_key, count(*) AS attempts, sum(cost_usd) AS cost, bool_and(priced) AS priced,
         sum(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE accepted) AS accepted_cost, COALESCE(bool_or(accepted), false) AS answered,
         sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens
  FROM llm_call_costs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) AND group_key IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY purpose, group_key
)
SELECT COALESCE(purpose, '합계(한도 1회)') AS purpose,
       count(*) AS requests,
       avg(cost) FILTER (WHERE priced) AS cost_per_request,
       avg(accepted_cost) FILTER (WHERE priced AND answered) AS accepted_cost_per_request,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost) FILTER (WHERE priced) AS p50_cost,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost) FILTER (WHERE priced) AS p95_cost,
       avg(attempts) AS attempts_per_request,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY input_tokens) AS p95_input_tokens,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY output_tokens) AS p95_output_tokens,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT answered) AS unanswered,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT priced) AS unpriced
FROM g WHERE purpose IN ('PERSONALIZED', 'ACTION_REVISION')
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((purpose), ())
ORDER BY purpose

panels.title: Layer A 단가 — 법령 버전 1건
panels.description: 배치 summarize 의 선계산 비용. 요청 1건 = 법령 버전 1건의 요약 또는 변경점.

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT purpose, group_key, count(*) AS attempts, sum(cost_usd) AS cost, bool_and(priced) AS priced,
         sum(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE accepted) AS accepted_cost, COALESCE(bool_or(accepted), false) AS answered,
         sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens
  FROM llm_call_costs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) AND group_key IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY purpose, group_key
)
SELECT purpose, sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE priced) AS total_cost,
       count(*) AS requests,
       avg(cost) FILTER (WHERE priced) AS cost_per_request,
       avg(accepted_cost) FILTER (WHERE priced AND answered) AS accepted_cost_per_request,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost) FILTER (WHERE priced) AS p50_cost,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cost) FILTER (WHERE priced) AS p95_cost,
       avg(attempts) AS attempts_per_request,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY input_tokens) AS p95_input_tokens,
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY output_tokens) AS p95_output_tokens,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT answered) AS unanswered,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT priced) AS unpriced
FROM g WHERE purpose IN ('SUMMARY', 'DIFF')
GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY purpose

panels.title: 재생성 비율
panels.description: 첫 개인화 1건당 상황 반영 재생성 수. 높으면 하루 한도가 빨리 준다.

targets.rawSql:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT purpose, group_key, count(*) AS attempts, sum(cost_usd) AS cost, bool_and(priced) AS priced,
         sum(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE accepted) AS accepted_cost, COALESCE(bool_or(accepted), false) AS answered,
         sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(output_tokens) AS output_tokens
  FROM llm_call_costs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) AND group_key IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY purpose, group_key
)
SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'ACTION_REVISION'))::numeric
       / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE purpose = 'PERSONALIZED'), 0) AS ratio FROM g

panels.title: 재시도 낭비율 — 목적별
panels.description: 인용 검증에 실패했거나 호출이 실패해 버린 시도의 비용·호출 비율.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT purpose, sum(cost_usd) FILTER (WHERE accepted IS NOT TRUE) / NULLIF(sum(cost_usd), 0) AS wasted_cost_ratio,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE accepted IS NOT TRUE)::numeric / count(*) AS wasted_call_ratio
FROM llm_call_costs WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) AND group_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY purpose

panels.title: 출력 잘림률 — 목적별
panels.description: 출력 상한(thinking 포함)에 걸려 끊긴 응답의 비율. 0이 아니면 max-tokens 를 본다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT purpose, count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(stop_reason) IN ('max_tokens', 'length'))::numeric
       / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE succeeded OR stop_reason IS NOT NULL), 0) AS truncated_ratio,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(stop_reason) IN ('max_tokens', 'length')) AS truncated
FROM llm_call_costs WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) AND purpose NOT IN ('DISCOVERY_EMBED', 'INDEX_EMBED')
GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY purpose

panels.title: 첫 개인화의 요청 차원
panels.description: 호출은 늘 영향·대응을 함께 만든다. 한쪽만 요청한 비율이 높으면 그 차원만 만드는 가벼운 호출을 검토한다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT requested, count(DISTINCT group_key) AS requests FROM llm_call_costs
WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) AND purpose = 'PERSONALIZED' GROUP BY requested ORDER BY requests DESC

SELECT purpose, avg(input_tokens::numeric / NULLIF(context_sources, 0)) AS input_tokens_per_source,
       avg(context_sources) AS sources_per_call
FROM llm_call_costs WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) AND context_sources IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY purpose ORDER BY purpose

panels.title: 기록 누락
panels.description: llm_calls 에 남기지 못한 호출(대기열 초과·쓰기 실패). 청구액 대조 때 차이를 설명한다.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT purpose, model, count(*) AS calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT succeeded) AS failed,
       avg(input_tokens) AS avg_input_tokens, sum(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd
FROM llm_call_costs WHERE $__timeFilter(called_at) AND purpose IN ('CLASSIFY', 'DISCOVERY_EMBED', 'INDEX_EMBED')
GROUP BY purpose, model ORDER BY purpose, model
